ToggleCell.notes: Cue/output/recording action command; no fixed shipped Object Tree property target is written by the command itself.

ToggleCue.notes: Cue playback/action command. It may start, stop, pause, restart, or emulate click gestures, but the bundled Object Tree index exposes no stable cue running/paused/pressed state property; a CueDown/CueUp probe did not change Grid.CellIndex.

ToggleFX.notes: Runtime toggle command. Probe ToggleFX 1 left Master.FX1Mute unchanged at 0; no stable direct property write target was confirmed.

ToggleMuteProTrack.notes: Runtime readback confirmed ProTrack mute commands write ProTrack.N.Mute. MuteProTrack 1 set ProTrack.0.Mute=1; UnmuteProTrack 1 restored it to 0. MuteAllProTracks also set ProTrack.0.Mute=1 and UnmuteAllProTracks restored it.

ToggleMuteZone.notes: Runtime readback confirmed direct zone mute commands write Zone.N.Mute and the mirror Zone.N.Muted. Unlike SelectZone, MuteZone/UnmuteZone accepted zero-based input for Zone.0 in the probe.

ToggleMuteZoneOfProjector.notes: Runtime readback confirmed ToggleMuteZoneOfProjector flips Zone.N.Mute and Zone.N.Muted for zones assigned to the named projector. In the lab, projector indices 1, 2, and 3 target Zone.0, Zone.1, and Zone.2 respectively; -1, 0, and 4 were no-ops.

ToggleSelectFixt.notes: Fixture selection command. The current Object Tree index exposes no fixture selection property, so classify as UI selection state rather than a direct property setter.

ToggleSelectProjector.notes: Projector selection command. Runtime probe found no reliable Projector.N.Selected property in the current Object Tree; Zone.N.Selected remained unchanged, so classify this as UI selection state rather than a direct property setter.

ToggleSelectProTrack.notes: Runtime readback confirmed ProTrack selection commands write ProTrack.N.Selected. SelectProTrack 1 selected ProTrack.0; UnselectAllProTracks restored selection to 0.

ToggleSelectZone.notes: Runtime readback confirmed zone selection commands write Zone.N.Selected. SelectZone/Toggle/UnSelect use 1-based command input mapped to zero-based Zone.N readback paths; SelectZoneName and UnSelectZoneName were verified against Zone.0.Name.

ToggleSoloProTrack.notes: Runtime readback via readBeyondProperty confirmed ProTrack solo commands write ProTrack.N.Solo: SoloProTrack 1 changed ProTrack.0.Solo from 0 to 1, ToggleSoloProTrack 1 changed it back to 0, and UnSoloProTrack 1 cleared it after another SoloProTrack 1. Restored with UnSoloAllProTrack.
